method: closing critic:monsters, fighter-review method (as monsters-1). Sheet: art/renders/units/<id>.png (three.js, built by art/blender/units/creatures[_b].py). In game: node _harness/value_probe.mjs --maps rift --tiers high --monsters only --t 70|370 --monsterIds <ids> --report fw_CW4_monsters2.json (RIFT, 1920x1080, 28.5 m, fog off) -> _harness/_reports/fw_CW4_monsters2.json, shots _harness/_shots/value_rift_high_<tag>_mon_<id>.png. Metrics as in glasshorn/_review.json.
gate: hp >= the lane's hp (1.18-1.19) and breakup >= 6 where the faces allow; |dL*| >= 20 against the camp floor; L* p90 <= 86; no horror/face read; sensitivity: no tall/pointed hood

umber mane (#6A4630) frosted cream at the tips (#EAD6B2, tips start lower)
cream belly, dark legs and hooves; carved-stone tusks unchanged
